headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate advanced machine learning models to predict and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI packages, including potential vulnerabilities in binding.gyp files. Leverage natural language processing (NLP) for improved documentation analysis and user guidance.
actions: Implement an AI model that analyzes package dependencies and historical data to identify potential security threats before installation.
Use NLP techniques to automatically generate clear, concise explanations of why certain packages might pose risks, guiding users on safer alternatives or config
Develop a real-time risk assessment feature that continuously monitors installed packages for updates or vulnerabilities, alerting users proactively.
